sentences.text: 02. Institution of this writ petition is of 2nd March, 2024.
03. There is an operating direction in terms of Order dated 4th March, 2024 for status quo meant for the five official respondents to abide by.
04. Reply on behalf of the respondents has come forward.

05. Through the medium of an application CM No. 6426/2024, two applicants namely Nazir Ahmad Bhat and Abdul Rashid Shergojri have come forward with an application filed on 15th October, 2025 thereby seeking their impleadment as respondents to resist the writ petition of the petitioner.

06. The applicants have pleaded in the application that under the garb of the status quo order, the writ petitioner is not only harassing the applicants but also not letting the residents of the area to use the pathway which is used for ingress and egress by them in relation to khasra No. 809 which obtains as pathway connecting the residential houses of the two applicants.
07. The pendency of this application has lasted almost eleven months.
08. For the reasons stated in the application, the same is allowed.
The two applicants namely Nazir Ahmad Bhat and Abdul Rashid Shergojri are added as respondents No. 6 and 7 to the writ petition subject to just exceptions from the petitioners' end.
09. The newly added respondents are directed to come up with the reply to the writ petition by or before the next date of hearing.

opennyai_summary.decision:
. The petitioner-Gul Mohammad Magrey is seeking a following relief in the form of issuance of writ, direction or order to the following effect:
"i. Writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus commanding upon the respondents to ensure that the petitioner is not being dispossessed from any portion of land falling under khasra No. 809 situated at Saimoh Tehsil Tral;
ii. Writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus, commanding upon the respondents to ensure that in case any portion of the proprietary land of the petitioner is required for construction of public road, the same shall be acquired strictly in accordance with provisions of Land Revenue Act and Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act of 2013;
iii. Writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus, restraining the respondents from laying concrete road through proprietary land of the petition."
02. Institution of this writ petition is of 2nd March, 2024.
07. The pendency of this application has lasted almost eleven months.
08. For the reasons stated in the application, the same is allowed.
The two applicants namely Nazir Ahmad Bhat and Abdul Rashid Shergojri are added as respondents No. 6 and 7 to the writ petition subject to just exceptions from the petitioners' end.
09. The newly added respondents are directed to come up with the reply to the writ petition by or before the next date of hearing.
